name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=game/ui options, descriptor=options_menu_loop). Accurately reflects purpose: the in-game Options/settings menu loop toggling BGM/SE/Speed/Other. No Ghidra address residue. Caller fd2_field_command_menu_loop invokes it from menu option 2 (OPTIONS), confirming the name.
purpose: In-game Options/settings menu loop: presents a 4-direction (cross) toggle menu for BGM, SE (SFX), game Speed, and an 'Other' (terrain-HUD) preference, applying each chosen toggle until the player cancels.
logic_summary: Copies the 16B slots template (@0x51EAF) into menu_options[0..3] and the 16B all-zero state template (@0x53F02) into menu_state[0..3], zeroes data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx. Loops: rebuild the 4 text-token labels from current toggle states (BGM 0x12/0x13, SE 0x14/0x15, Speed 0x16/0x17, Other 0x18/0x19), open the slide-in dialog, poll fd2_settings_menu_input_step until non-zero (0=navigating,1=selection,-1=cancel), close the dialog. On cancel (-1) return. On selection, dispatch on cursor index: 0 toggles data_fd2_audio_bgm_enabled_flag and calls AIL_set_sequence_volume(handle, on?0x7F:0, 1000) for a 1-sec BGM fade; 2 XORs data_fd2_ui_game_speed_flag; 3 XORs data_fd2_ui_terrain_hud_user_enabled; else toggles data_fd2_audio_sfx_enabled_flag via explicit 0/1 store. Then re-render and continue.

returns.semantics: No return value; loops until the player cancels the settings menu (Esc -> input step returns -1), then returns to the caller.

notes: Src comment block (menucfg.c lines 10-30) was already accurate and precise vs the decompilation (correctly notes the __CHK(0x3c) prologue, the per-label toggle conditions, and the explicit 0/1 SFX store); kept as-is. Confirmed all 8 referenced globals' live Ghidra names via symbol lookup. Ghidra function plate was stale for slot 3: it called the global 'tile_anim_lookup_table[0x14]' (old name) and described it as a generic 'variant flag'. The global has been renamed to data_fd2_ui_terrain_hud_user_enabled and its own data plate documents it as the per-save cursor terrain-info HUD overlay toggle (Game Options option 3). Updated the function plate to use the current global names throughout and the correct slot-3 semantics, consistent with src; saved program. No parameters (void). No logic concerns found; decompilation matches the verified src exactly.
